tabs.overview: Boxes set on the station open from the bottom onto a belt or screw that feeds the blender hopper; a shuttle forklift keeps full boxes coming and takes empties away. The alternative to silos on pads that run containerized sand.
tabs.engineering: Throughput by the design's sand rate; box count on the pad by the stages before the next delivery.
tabs.safety: Forklift traffic is the main exposure around the station; dust control at the box outlet.
tabs.evidence: Pad photographs read for layout and proportion only (S9).

name: Sand box station
function: The unloading station that takes sand boxes from the forklift and meters their sand onto the blender's conveyor.
